decisions.decision: Kill stale 2-hour scan, implement parallel scandir + parallel stat()
decisions.rationale: Sequential os.walk + serial stat() was causing multi-hour wait before hashing even started

decisions.decision: Use os.scandir DirEntry metadata instead of os.walk
decisions.rationale: DirEntry caches file type/symlink status from directory listing — no extra SMB round-trips per entry

decisions.decision: Bulk SELECT catalog into dict instead of N individual queries
decisions.rationale: 533K individual should_skip() DB queries was a major bottleneck

decisions.decision: Keep folder nesting max 2 levels in output library
decisions.rationale: SMB walk time scales with directory count not file count — deep nesting (Google Drive) caused worst delays
